entities.name: Duskmoor
entities.description: A hybrid child raised by spirits who carries the gene memory to end dragons.
entities.quote: He was named Duskmoor: Moonlight carried through darkness. Not rage-born. Not power-hungry. Judgement-born.

entities.name: Duskmoors
entities.description: A lineage formed from the collision of spirit morality, human adaptability, and dragon arrogance.
entities.quote: Duskmoors are not dragon-slayers by training. They are dragon-enders by origin. They are what happens when: ● spirit morality ● human adaptability ● and dragon arrogance collide into one lineage.
